subject: reasoning
question:
Aamir, Bunty, Leslie, Pradeep, Ishaan, Faiz, Gaurav and Harish are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners of the table, while some are sitting exactly in the middle of the sides of the table. Pradeep is sitting third to the right of Gaurav. Pradeep is sitting at a corner. Bunty sits second to the right of Faiz. Faiz is not sitting at any corner. Bunty is not sitting immediate next to Pradeep. Harish is sitting immediately next to Aamir. Harish is not sitting in the middle of any side of the table. Only one person sits between Harish and Leslie.

Who is sitting second to the left of Bunty?
solution:
**Given : **

 
• Aamir, Bunty, Leslie, Pradeep, Ishaan, Faiz, Gaurav and Harish are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table.
 
• Some of them are sitting at the corners of the table, while some are sitting exactly in the middle of the sides of the table.

**Explanation : **

1) Pradeep is sitting at a corner.

2) Pradeep is sitting third to the right of Gaurav.
